title: Audit: Mozilla Foundation — funding.apply_url / profile currency incorrect
summary: File presents Mozilla Technology Fund (MTF) as Mozilla's live, applyable fund with a working apply_url. That URL now redirects to Mozilla's generic grantmaking hub, which no longer lists MTF among its current programs (Incubator, Mozilla Fellows, Responsible Computing Challenge, Collaborative Funds). MTF ran exactly three cohorts (2022-2024, ~$1M total) with no cohort found since. Mozilla's current live themed/mentored $50k-cohort vehicle is the 'Incubator' program (launched Nov 2025), currently running 'Democracy x AI Cohort 2026'. A BD person following the file's apply_url today lands on a dead-end generic page, not an active call for proposals.

orgs/mozilla-foundation.yaml.profile_note: Reframe MTF as historical (2022-2024, ~$1M across 3 cohorts, program page now redirects to the generic grantmaking hub). Mozilla's current live themed-cohort/mentorship vehicle is the 'Incubator' program (launched Nov 2025), currently running 'Democracy x AI Cohort 2026' at up to $50,000 + up to $250,000 Sustain Track.

title: Audit: Shuttleworth Foundation — status incorrect
summary: File's status is 'unknown', hedged in the profile as 'current status is unclear.' The Foundation publicly announced on its own blog (July 19 2022) it was closing 'by the beginning of 2024,' ending its 17-year fellowship model after 56 fellows. Wikipedia independently confirms the closure. This is a confirmed shutdown, not an ambiguous stale page.

title: Audit: Shuttleworth Foundation — website incorrect (dead domain)
summary: Listed website https://shuttleworthfoundation.org returns a bare HTTP 404 (nginx placeholder) on every path when checked via direct curl, on both www and non-www. An AI-oriented fetch of the same domain returned fabricated-looking content that varied suspiciously by URL slug — signs of cloaking on a lapsed, re-registered domain; do not trust automated fetches of this domain. Wikipedia's current citation points to shuttleworthfoundation.com instead, but that domain is an explicit unofficial fan project ('No somos la fundacion original... No otorgamos becas... No estamos afiliados oficialmente con Mark Shuttleworth') — there is no live official Shuttleworth Foundation website.

orgs/shuttleworth-foundation.yaml.website: (dead — 404 confirmed via direct curl on every path; no live official site exists)

title: Audit: SERI MATS (MATS Program) — name incorrect
summary: File's primary name is 'SERI MATS (MATS Program).' The program no longer uses 'SERI MATS' as its name: current site describes it simply as 'MATS', run by the independent nonprofit 'MATS Research', with no mention of Stanford. The SERI (Stanford Existential Risks Initiative) affiliation was dropped by the Winter 2023-24 cohort when the program became an independent 501(c)(3). Leading with 'SERI MATS' in a BD-facing registry risks implying a current Stanford affiliation that no longer exists. All funding mechanics/figures (10-week program, $1,250/week stipend, $2,000/week compute budget, Berkeley/London, 527+ researchers since 2021) are independently confirmed correct.

Also worth noting: as of the fetch the most recent cycle shows 'Closed for submissions' (deadline Nov 21 2025, offers by end of March 2026) — 'active' is defensible for a recurring fellowship but the current-cycle nuance isn't captured.
